topic: mind wandering, experience sampling, thought probes, task performance, questionnaires, fMRI, EEG, eye movements, and physiological correlates
unique_angle: Mind-wandering research compares momentary self-report, task-related performance, questionnaires, and neural or physiological proxies; no single measure is a live recording of private thought or a universal attention trait.

safety_boundary: Public education only. Mind-wandering probes, task errors, questionnaires, and neural or physiological signals are task-specific observables and are not diagnosis, treatment, direct thought reading, or individualized cognitive assessment.
